author: Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-03

amends.rule: All v2 fields stand unless overridden below. v2 file is not modified.

question: Does one verifier-filtered self-training LoRA generation of Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B solve more of 32 sealed 8x8 Sokoban holdout puzzles than its frozen parent, beyond what chance flips explain?
why_gpu: Requires forward+backward through a 35.95B-param BF16 MoE (67 GiB weights). Not runnable on the Mac (33 GiB free disk, no CUDA).
hypothesis_H1: P1 (epoch-3 adapter, reloaded) solves more holdout puzzles than P0, by a margin a one-sided exact sign test on discordant pairs accepts at alpha=0.05.
primary_metric: Paired discordant counts on 32 holdouts: b = P0 fail -> P1 solve, c = P0 solve -> P1 fail. Greedy decoding, identical batch composition and order for P0 and P1.
baseline: P0 = frozen parent, same prompts/template/decoding, measured in the same session before any update.
pass_threshold: PASS iff one-sided exact binomial p(X>=b | n=b+c, 0.5) <= 0.05, i.e. (b>=5,c=0) or (b>=7,c<=1) or (b>=9,c<=2). Overrides v2 'P1>P0 and zero regressions' (b=1,c=0 has p=0.50).
fail: Completed run with p>0.05 => FAIL (no improvement shown). Any regression count c is reported regardless.

stop_outcomes_not_fail.NO_HEADROOM: P0 solved >= 28/32 (b>=5 impossible) -> stop before training.
stop_outcomes_not_fail.FLOOR: P0 solved <= 1/32 AND accepted corpus < 8 -> stop.
stop_outcomes_not_fail.NO_ELIGIBLE_CORPUS: < 8 fail-then-self-fixed tasks across >= 2 depth bands -> stop.
stop_outcomes_not_fail.INCOMPLETE: Any operational/time/disk/memory failure -> export partials, stop, UNGRADED.

amendment_corpus_cap: Raise model-generated board cap from 16 to 48 (still 512 new tokens each, batched) because the fail-then-fix window is narrow; training set still capped at 16 accepted tasks (first 16 by generation order).
amendment_stage_gate: If P0 eval + corpus generation are not complete by T+80 min from START, stop as INCOMPLETE.
model_forecast: v2 integer forecast kept as SECONDARY; graded HIT/MISS exactly and also |error|. Never a pass criterion.

claude_locked_prediction.note: Author's judgment, written before any data exists; graded after run.

relabel_step.reason: Sokoban study uses no governance rows; verifier is deterministic BFS.
relabel_step.blocker: independent-labeling-readiness.json: 0/12 original situation texts recovered; a blind relabel of label-only rows is not meaningful. Kappa plan: if texts are ever recovered, one blinded labeler, 5-class vocabulary, Cohen's kappa vs author labels; kappa<0.6 => historical 41.67%/66.7% figures are unreliable.

unbound_before_GO: holdout generator seed + 32 board hashes + depth quotas
exact pip lock (transformers>=5.8.1, peft, torch, fla/causal-conv1d)
